claim: The BFP charter classifies Simple transactions as processed within 1 day, Complex within 3 days, and Highly Technical within 7 days. It directs readers to JMC2021-01 for classification coverage. The source says days, not working days, and identifies FIRE STATION/OSCP/BOSS.

evidence.source_span:
OFFICE 
 FIRE STATION/OSCP/BOSS
CLASSIFICATIONS
1. SIMPLE TRANSACTION - TRANSACTION PROCESSED WITHIN ONE (1) DAY 
2. COMPLEX TRANSACTION - TRANSACTION PROCESSED WITHIN THREE (3) DAYS 
3. HIGHLY TECHNICAL TRANSACTION - TRANSACTION PROCESSED WITHIN SEVEN (7) DAYS
NOTE: For the coverage of Simple, Complex and Highly Technical Transactions refer to Joint Memorandum Circular (JMC) No. 2021-01  
Series of 2021 “Amending the DILG-DPWH-DICT-DTI JMC No. 2018-01 or the Guidelines in the Processing of Construction-Related Permits”
